label: Agent proposal 1
hypothesis: Enabling entity and as-of-date filtering will prevent cross-entity distractors and exclude records outside the requested validity interval, improving complete-scenario task success without changing write admission or hard-constraint behavior.
predicted_effect: Entity-grounding and distractor retrieval should return the requested entity, while historical-address and future-move should select the record valid at the requested as-of date. Retrieval noise and stale-fact errors should decrease.
